request: Refactor the reviewer so that approval is rule-based, not opinion-based. Define explicit pass/fail criteria including: (1) all plan steps must be completed, (2) no execution issues allowed, (3) required sections must exist for documentation tasks, (4) improvements must be measurable vs previous version. If any rule fails, reviewer MUST return 'revise' with specific actionable fixes. Approval should only happen if ALL rules pass.
title: Refactor reviewer for rule-based approval system
goals: Implement a rule-based approval system for the reviewer
Define explicit pass/fail criteria for plan completion, execution issues, documentation sections, and measurable improvements
Ensure the reviewer returns 'revise' with specific actionable fixes if any rule fails
Ensure approval occurs only if all rules pass
constraints: Approval must strictly follow the defined rules
success_criteria: The reviewer uses a rule-based system to approve or return 'revise'
All plan steps are verified as completed before approval
No execution issues are present in the final output
Required sections exist in documentation tasks
Improvements are measurable against the previous version
